title: The Iron Seed
text: A seed of iron lies in a cold crucible, no bigger than an acorn, dull and heavy. When warmed in the hand, it stirs. A tiny root uncurls from it, red as rust and thin as a hair, feeling for something to grow into.

options.label: Plant it in the forge's ashes, and let it grow where it belongs.

outcomes.text: An iron sapling, red as rust, and the ruins feel a little less dead.

options.label: The wisest keeps it close, curious what it will grow into.

outcomes.text: It grows, slowly, into something worth having, and its roots like the warmth of a body.

options.label: Melt it down. Iron that grows roots is iron that wants something.

outcomes.text: Good iron, and a feeling of having killed something small.
